description: This source file 'http_header.c' provides implementations for manipulating HTTP headers within a web server or proxy. It includes functions to get, set, unset, append, and parse HTTP headers both in request and response contexts, along with internal data structures for header recognition and management.

methods.name: enum:http_header_e http_header_hkey_get(const char * const s,const size_t slen)
methods.description: Returns the enum http_header_e corresponding to the header key string, case-insensitive, or HTTP_HEADER_OTHER if not recognized.

methods.name: int http_header_str_to_code(const char * const s)
